marketing_description: The NUVO Tape Light is a versatile and energy efficient solution, featuring a durable plastic construction and easy installation. With a dimmable LED bulb and adjustable beam angle, this 16 ft long tape light provides 1120 lumens of light and is suitable for wall mounting. It offers a long lasting average life of 50000 hours and is available in a range of color temperatures from 2700 to 6500 K.
